detailedProjects.title: Open-Care
detailedProjects.problem: Healthcare information in Bangladesh was fragmented — finding doctors, hospitals, ambulance services, and blood donation resources required navigating multiple disconnected sources.
detailedProjects.context: Personal open-source project. Designed to make healthcare information searchable and accessible in one place.
detailedProjects.role: Lead contributor — backend architecture, API design, authorization, and deployment.
contributions: Built a Spring Boot REST API with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Keycloak-based authorization
Integrated MinIO for file storage and Liquibase for database migrations
Documented the API with Swagger/OpenAPI for developer discoverability
Containerized the application with Docker and deployed to production
Developed the Next.js frontend interface
detailedProjects.architecture: Spring Boot REST API backed by PostgreSQL with Keycloak-based RBAC, MinIO file storage, Liquibase migrations, and a Next.js frontend. Containerized with Docker.

challenges.challenge: Designing an authorization model flexible enough for multiple user types (patients, doctors, organizations)
challenges.solution: Used Keycloak with role-based access control and token introspection to enforce access rules across all API routes

challenges.challenge: Making healthcare resource data searchable and consistently structured across many provider types
challenges.solution: Designed a normalized PostgreSQL schema with clear provider-type boundaries and Redis caching for frequently accessed directory data

lessons: Keycloak's role-based model scales well when authorization rules are defined early in schema design
Swagger/OpenAPI documentation significantly reduces friction for contributors and API consumers
Liquibase migrations keep schema evolution traceable and reproducible across environments

detailedProjects.title: Election Management System
detailedProjects.tagline: Distributed backend for a national election platform
detailedProjects.problem: Managing candidate nominations, verification, and result workflows for a national election required a secure, high-availability distributed system capable of handling peak-period traffic.
detailedProjects.context: Commercial platform at Penta Global Ltd. comprising nearly 25 microservices. Supports 50,000 users and approximately 100,000 daily requests during election periods.
detailedProjects.role: Senior Software Engineer — backend delivery lead for candidate lifecycle, reporting service, and authorization.
contributions: Led backend task allocation, grooming, planning, implementation guidance, and code reviews within a 30-person development team
Designed REST API contracts for nomination lifecycle, candidate review, verification, payment-linked submission, and report generation
Owned a reporting service that consolidated data from multiple services to generate official nomination, affidavit, candidate, schedule, and result PDF reports
Applied Keycloak-backed authorization and workflow validation across sensitive nomination state transitions
Replaced manual result-center, voter, candidate, and percentage-calculation workflows with digital system workflows for approximately 300 returning officers
Used RabbitMQ for election workflows and contributed to approximately 30 deployments via Dockerfiles, Nginx configuration, and GitHub Actions CI/CD
detailedProjects.architecture: Microservices architecture of nearly 25 services. Services communicate via REST and RabbitMQ. Keycloak handles SSO and RBAC. Deployed to a self-managed Kubernetes data center with CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

challenges.challenge: Coordinating data across nearly 25 distributed services while generating consistent official reports
challenges.solution: Owned a dedicated reporting service that fetched and consolidated data from upstream services via REST, then rendered official PDF reports using a consistent template

challenges.challenge: Enforcing nomination workflow rules across sensitive state transitions with different authority levels
challenges.solution: Applied Keycloak-backed role authorization combined with server-side state transition validation on each API route

challenges.challenge: Supporting approximately 100,000 daily requests during election periods versus 10,000 outside elections
challenges.solution: Deployed on Kubernetes with horizontal scaling; used Docker and CI/CD pipelines to support approximately 30 production deployments

metrics.label: Users
metrics.description: Internal platform users during election periods

lessons: Owning a cross-service reporting layer requires careful dependency management and resilient data fetching
Keycloak's token introspection and role enforcement scales well in a microservices environment when applied consistently
CI/CD and Kubernetes support frequent deployments but require disciplined Dockerfile and Nginx configuration practices

detailedProjects.title: Exam Management System
detailedProjects.tagline: Production exam platform serving thousands of students and administrators
detailedProjects.problem: Educational institutions were managing exams manually, leading to operational inefficiency, delayed result processing, and limited visibility for administrators.
detailedProjects.context: Production system at Dynamic Solution Innovators Ltd. deployed across multiple educational institutions.
detailedProjects.role: Lead Developer — requirement analysis, database schema design, backend development, and production deployment.
contributions: Led development end-to-end: requirement analysis, database schema design, backend implementation, and production deployment
Implemented Redis caching which reduced system response time by 30%
Built a real-time administrator dashboard associated with a reported 40% increase in system usage
Developed Crystal Reports integration for result cards, transcripts, and operational reports
Built a Flutter mobile interface for exam-related access
Used Jenkins for CI/CD and Locust for load testing
detailedProjects.architecture: Three-tier architecture — Spring Boot backend with PostgreSQL, Flutter mobile frontend, and Crystal Reports for document generation. Redis caching for high-traffic data paths. Jenkins for CI/CD, Locust for load testing.

challenges.challenge: High-traffic result access during result publication periods
challenges.solution: Implemented Redis caching for result data and exam session information, reducing repeated database load during peak usage

challenges.challenge: Generating printable result cards and administrative reports at scale
challenges.solution: Integrated Crystal Reports with the backend to generate structured PDFs from database-backed report templates

metrics.label: Students
metrics.description: Students supported for registration and payment

lessons: Redis caching is high-impact for read-heavy exam and student data workflows
Load testing with Locust before production release surfaces bottlenecks that unit tests miss
Designing the database schema early — before implementation — significantly reduces migration debt

detailedProjects.title: National e-GP System
detailedProjects.problem: The Bangladesh government procurement process required a digital platform that could handle complex workflows, large-file uploads, and strict data integrity across government agencies.
detailedProjects.context: National-level e-governance platform at Dohatec New Media, used across government, non-government, and enterprise organizations.
detailedProjects.role: Java Software Engineer — feature development, bug fixing, and stakeholder-aligned delivery.
contributions: Implemented new features and resolved bugs in the procurement platform while preserving data integrity
Contributed to large-file upload workflows and relational data modeling for complex procurement entities
Applied iterative, agile, and incremental delivery practices in collaboration with stakeholders and product teams
Supported long-term software partnerships across government, non-government, and enterprise organizations
detailedProjects.architecture: Enterprise application with modular procurement workflows, relational database modeling, and large-file upload support.

challenges.challenge: Handling large-file uploads reliably within an enterprise procurement workflow
challenges.solution: Contributed to file upload handling and workflow integration to support document-heavy procurement submissions

challenges.challenge: Maintaining data privacy and integrity across a multi-stakeholder government platform
challenges.solution: Applied access controls and data validation practices aligned with platform requirements during feature development and bug fixes

lessons: Long-running government platform work develops deep familiarity with enterprise-grade workflow complexity
Data integrity constraints and stakeholder alignment are as important as technical implementation in government systems
